```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidygenclust)
library(resrepo)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Set cores
n_cores <- 15
data.table::setDTthreads(n_cores)
bigparallelr::set_blas_ncores(n_cores)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s05_fastmixture/"
```

This script uses fastMIXTURE (Santander et al., 2024) through the package tidypopgen (Carter and Manica, 2025), and clumppling (ref) through the package tidygenclust (ref) to estimate ancestry proportions of individuals in the global dataset. 

# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt",
    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld"
  )
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

fastMIXTURE was run on the full, cleaned dataset of `r nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` individuals and `r count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` SNPs.

```{r}
if (file.exists("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")) {
  qmats <-
    readRDS("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
} else {
  tictoc::tic()
  k <- c(2:10)
  qmats <- gt_fastmixture(mad_bor_g1000_sum,
    k,
    n_runs = 3,
    threads = 1,
    batches = 16,
    seed = c(1, 2, 3),
    no_freqs = TRUE,
    cv = 5,
    cv_tole = 1e-7
  )
  saveRDS(qmats, "../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
  time <- tictoc::toc()
}
```

fastMIXTURE was run unsupervised for k values `min(range(unique(qmats$k)))` to `r max(range(unique(qmats$k)))`, with `r rle(qmats$k)$lengths[1]` repeats. 

```{r}
qmats <- readRDS("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
```


```{r}
# check order
testthat::expect_equal(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id)
testthat::expect_equal(qmats$group, mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)
```


# Reorder gen_tibble

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region <- "Other"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor"), "Region"] <- "Island southeast Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("BEB", "PJL"), "Region"] <- "South Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("CHS", "KHV"), "Region"] <- "East Asia"
# Not really happy about grouping all African samples here though...
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("ESN", "GWD", "LWK", "MSL", "YRI"), "Region"] <- "Africa"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"), "Region"] <- "Malagasy"
# wharerver is left as "Other" set to Africa
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region == "Other", "Region"] <- "Africa"

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% arrange(Region, population)
```

# Reorder qmats according to population order in mad_bor_g1000_sum

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(.data$id %in% qmats$id)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum[match(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id), ]

region <- mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region
region <- factor(region, levels = unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region))

qmats <- gt_admix_reorder_q(qmats, group = region)
```

# CV

```{r}
autoplot(qmats, type = "cv")
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "fastmixture_cv_error.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

Cross validation error indicates that low values of K are unsuitable to describe variation in the dataset. We therefore explore K = 6 and above.

# Clumppling

```{r}
clump <- gt_clumppling(input_path = qmats)
```

```{r}
out <- clump %>% autoplot(
  type = "all_modes",
  group = as.character(qmats$group)
)
out
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "clumppling_all_modes.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
devtools::load_all("/home/EJC199/Git/tidygenclust")

# subset according to index
sub_clump <- subset_gt_clumppling(clump, k = 6:10)

# with group labels
sub_clump %>% autoplot(
  type = "all_modes",
  group = as.character(qmats$group)
)
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "clumppling_all_modes_k6_10.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

# subset according to index
sub_clump <- subset_gt_clumppling(clump, k = 6)

# with group labels
sub_clump %>% autoplot(
  type = "all_modes",
  group = as.character(qmats$group)
)
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "clumppling_all_modes_k6.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
clump %>% autoplot(type = "major_modes")

```

```{r}

clump_out
```

```{r}
autoplot(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 6, run = 1),
```

# Add Malagasy population names

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region <- ifelse(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region == "Malagasy",
  mad_bor_g1000_sum$population,
  mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region
)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% arrange(Region, population)
```

# Reorder qmats according to population order in mad_bor_g1000_sum

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(.data$id %in% qmats$id)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum[match(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id), ]
# rename mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region "Sakalava Tsimihety" to "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region[mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region == "Sakalava_Tsimihety"] <- "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
# rename mad_bor_g1000_sum$population "Diego" to "Diego Mixed"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region[mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region == "Diego"] <- "Diego Mixed"

region <- mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region
region <- factor(region, levels = unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region))

qmats <- gt_admix_reorder_q(qmats, group = region)
```

# Plot

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%

autoplot(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 6, run = 1),

  arrange_by_indiv = TRUE,

) +
  theme( # Rotate and adjust alignment

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "fastmixture_k6_malagasy_named.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```



# Check which ancestry components each .Q represents

```{r}
augmented <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1),
  data = mad_bor_g1000_sum
)

# filter augmented to $population CHS and print head
augmented_chs <- augmented %>% filter(population == "CHS")
head(augmented_chs) # .Q1 representing Asian ancestry

augmented_gwd <- augmented %>% filter(population == "GWD")
head(augmented_gwd)
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s05_fastmixture.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  res_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)
```
